name: groundmail
description: Add transactional email to your app with Groundmail: skills for the API, official SDKs and SMTP, plus the hosted Groundmail MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Add transactional email to the app you are building: password resets, receipts, sign-in codes and alerts. The skills teach Codex the Groundmail API, the official SDKs (Node, Python, Go, PHP, Ruby) and SMTP, including test sends, idempotency keys and error handling. The hosted MCP server lets Codex send and look up email, set up and verify sending domains, and manage templates, webhooks and suppressions. You sign in with your Groundmail account and choose Full, Send only or Read only access. Your sign-in codes and receipts never share IPs with marketing email, and the free plan sends 3,000 emails a month with no time limit. Groundmail is for email your app sends to its own users, not cold outreach or bulk marketing.
